info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment Cancellation API allows users to effectively cancel shipments in the logistics system. This endpoint provides the necessary functionality to manage operational disruptions by removing shipment records that are no longer needed. Typical consumers include logistics managers and supply chain coordinators who require timely updates to shipment statuses. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their logistics operations and maintain accurate shipment tracking.

delete.description: This endpoint allows the user to cancel an existing shipment. Upon cancellation, the system will process the request and update the shipment status accordingly. Ensure that the shipment is eligible for cancellation before invoking this operation.

requestBody.description: This request is used to cancel an existing shipment. It requires specific information about the shipment that needs to be canceled, encapsulated in the request body.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for canceling shipments.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.title: Shipment Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: Response object returned after a shipment cancellation operation.
